name: Zack Spade
source:
Better known as Deathslinger, Zack is a solo operative within the Mercenary Guild. His discretion and lethal accuracy with a weapon makes him the perfect gun-for-hire. Zack tends to keep to himself which can make him appear aloof.

[From official website]
